Answer: D
Reason: The provided CT scans (Figures 1-5) demonstrate multiple soft tissue masses located in the pleural space (extrapleural), such as the large mass in the left upper chest and the mass at the left lung base. Several of these masses are associated with rib destruction or erosion (e.g., Figure 2 shows involvement of the posterior ribs, Figure 4 shows involvement of anterior/lateral ribs). Additionally, small nodular opacities are visible within the lung parenchyma near the pleura (subpleural nodules, e.g., Figure 3 and Figure 5). This constellation of findings indicates a multifocal intrathoracic recurrence.
